q.st-001.o1: No plans at all and nothing to do. Look around home: what if you slipped away for one night?
q.st-002.o1: Unfold the map and pick the lakeside campsite: close, quiet, water nearby.
q.st-003.o1: Drop by the outdoor gear shop.
q.st-003.o3: Get a sleeping bag: nights by the water are cool.
q.st-004.o1: Hit the road to the lake. No need to hurry: the road is part of the break too.
q.st-004.o2: The cat has curled up on the seat, watching the road. Drive smoothly: it's calmer that way.
q.elise-bike-area.choice: Look at the new bike area: Elise asked you to check the stand
q.elise-bike-area.o1: Talk to Elise: she needs someone on a bike to try out the new bike parking.
q.st-005.o1: Say hello to Elise at reception: she'll show you your pitch.
q.st-005.o2: Settle in for the night: ask Elise where.
q.st-005.o3: Gather some firewood for the evening.
q.st-005.o4: Your cat is already sniffing the new place. Give it a minute to look around.
ev.neighbours-firewood: Your campsite neighbours had firewood to spare and shared some with you.
pack.note.tent-car: No tent: we'll sleep in the car. That's a night too.
pack.note.tent-bike: No tent: there's a gazebo at the campsite.
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c1: Where can I leave the bike?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c2: Thanks! Where's a good spot for the tent?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c3: How's my bike doing under the shelter?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c4: Remind me where the tent should go?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c6: I came by bike, actually. Where can I park it?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c5: Just saying hi. Have a lovely evening!
dlg.elise-greeting.bike: By bike all the way? Respect! It'll stay dry under the shelter by my cabin.
dlg.elise-greeting.intro: By the way, I'm Elise: I look after everything here by the lake.
dlg.elise-greeting.shelter: Dry and cosy, as promised. I even oiled the chain: it squeaked across the meadow!
dlg.elise-greeting.spot: By the pines: quiet, lake view at dawn. The ground isn't obliged to be level.
dlg.elise-greeting.spot.c1: Lovely! I'll pitch my tent there.
dlg.elise-greeting.spot.c2: No tent with us. Can we sleep in the car?
dlg.elise-greeting.spot.c3: No tent with me. Where can I spend the night?
dlg.elise-greeting.spot.c4: I'll look around first, then decide.
dlg.elise-greeting.night-car: A car is a home too. Park by the pines: flat and quiet.
dlg.elise-greeting.gazebo: There's a gazebo by the water: roof, benches, hardly any wind. It's free.
dlg.elise-greeting.bye: Have a lovely evening! Need anything? I'm in the cabin with the green door.
dlg.road-apples.title: Apples by the road
dlg.road-apples.box: By the roadside: a wooden crate of apples and a sign — “Help yourself! From our orchard.”
dlg.road-apples.box.c1: Take an apple and leave a “Thank you!” note
dlg.road-apples.crunch: The apple is crisp and tart-sweet. The road suddenly feels shorter.
dlg.road-apples.wave: You quietly thank the unknown gardener. Maybe next time.
fact.nl-no-wild-camping: True wild camping is not allowed anywhere in the Netherlands: pitch a tent only where overnight stays are permitted.
fact.nl-signboard-rules: In Natuurmonumenten areas the yellow sign at the entrance lists what is allowed; anything not on it is not allowed.
fact.nl-sbb-pole-camping-closed: Staatsbosbeheer closed all 17 of its pole-camping sites from 1 June 2020, citing fires, litter and rule-breaking.
dlg.george-plan.hello: The list is almost done. Two questions left, then we go.
dlg.george-plan.hello.c3: We'll settle the rest on the way.
dlg.george-plan.gear: Basic set, or look at something better? I checked the prices.
dlg.george-plan.gear.c2: Let's look at better. It's not our last trip.
dlg.george-plan.gear-basic: Logical. One less thing on my list.
dlg.george-plan.gear-better: Fine. First, let's check what it'll cost.
dlg.george-plan.route: The route: do I lead, or do we hand it to Matthew?
dlg.george-plan.route.c1: You lead. You know where to stop for a break.
dlg.george-plan.route.c2: Let Matthew lead. He'll find a photo spot.
dlg.george-plan.route-matthew: Matthew leads. I'm only slightly nervous.
dlg.george-plan.bye: Deal. I'll check the list once more.
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c7: We made it! There's a story to tell.
dlg.elise-greeting.road: So, tell me: how was the trip?
dlg.elise-greeting.road.c1: There was a box of apples by the road. We helped ourselves.
dlg.elise-greeting.road.c2: George led the route. Says he checked everything.
dlg.elise-greeting.road.c3: Matthew led the route. He was hunting photo spots.
dlg.elise-greeting.road.c4: We only brought the basic gear.
dlg.elise-greeting.road.c5: We meant to look at something better than basic.
dlg.elise-greeting.road.c6: Nothing special. We just got here.
dlg.elise-greeting.road-apple: The best stops are the ones that weren't in the plan.
dlg.elise-greeting.road-george: Then he'll surely find my cabin with the green door.
dlg.elise-greeting.road-matthew: Tell him to try the jetty at sunrise. No better shot here.
dlg.elise-greeting.road-basic: Sensible. The lake doesn't care what the tent cost.
dlg.elise-greeting.road-better: Good gear is gear you use. The rest comes with experience.
dlg.elise-greeting.place: How do you like your spot?
dlg.elise-greeting.place.c1: It's quiet under the pines, just like you said.
dlg.elise-greeting.place.c2: By the water: we can see the lake from the tent.
dlg.elise-greeting.place.c3: We're sleeping in the car. Snug, and warm.
dlg.elise-greeting.place.c4: We're in the gazebo. You can hear the water lapping.
dlg.elise-greeting.place-pines: In the morning you'll see the lake between the trunks. Worth waking early.
dlg.elise-greeting.place-lake: Then the sunset is yours. Just don't forget a jumper.
dlg.elise-greeting.place-car: A car is a home too. And a lakeside morning is the same for everyone.
dlg.elise-greeting.place-gazebo: The gazebo loves guests. Hang your lantern on the hook under the roof.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice: Morning tip: unzip the tent and let it dry. Never pack it wet.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice.c2: Thanks, we'll probably do it our way.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice-yes: Lovely. A dry tent makes an easy trip home.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice-no: Of course. It's your trip, and the advice isn't going anywhere.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice-again.c1: The tent is drying, like you said.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice-again.c2: We did it our way, and it's fine.
dlg.elise-greeting.advice-again.c3: Just dropped by to say hi.
dlg.elise-greeting.again-yes: I can see! You learn fast.
dlg.elise-greeting.again-no: Good for you. What matters is you're happy here.
dlg.elise-greeting.spot.c5: Thanks, but I'll go closer to the water, to see the lake.
journal.f.pitch-lake-view: tent by the water, with a lake view
journal.f.road-apple: an apple from the roadside box, and a "Thank you!" note
journal.m.advice-taken: Eliza's tip to dry the tent in the morning: taken
journal.m.advice-declined: Eliza's tip: we did it our way
dlg.elise-greeting.spot.c6: The tent is already up. Thanks!
q.prologue-home-001.o1: Friday evening. A map on the table, a phone with the forecast and a note: “One free night”. Have a look around.
q.ch1-home-001.o1: Head home and pack: by hand or with “Pack automatically”.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-002.title: Rain at the Bend
dlg.ev.ch1.road-002.rain: Round the bend, sudden rain. But only over one field.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-002.rain.c1: Slow down and take a look
dlg.ev.ch1.road-002.sprinkler: Not a cloud — a farmer's sprinkler. It keeps a schedule too.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-002.dash: Two seconds, and dry again. The shortest rain of your life.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-003.title: A Signpost of Numbers
dlg.ev.ch1.road-003.sign: At the crossroads, a sign with cycle-junction numbers. Not a single name.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-003.map: Junction 47, then 12. Someone very calm must have planned this.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-003.main: The numbers can wait. The road is familiar; the pedals turn themselves.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.title: Three Identical Lanterns
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.stop: A short stop. George opens the boot to check everything's there.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.lanterns: Three identical lanterns. Matthew: “What if the first one goes on holiday?”
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.lanterns.c2: Let them ride. They need a break too
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.repack: Victoria: “It’s one night, not a stadium.”
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.keep: The lanterns ride on. All three, feeling rather important.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-004.go: Boot shut. George: “I checked. Everything is in place, nothing will fall out.”
dlg.ev.ch1.road-005.title: A Strange Silence in the Car
dlg.ev.ch1.road-005.quiet: The car is quiet. Matthew notices first: “Did we all fall asleep?”
dlg.ev.ch1.road-005.quiet.c2: Keep the quiet — it's rest too
dlg.ev.ch1.road-005.game: Victoria wins. The cow seems pleased as well.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-005.calm: The silence is warm, like a blanket. Nobody's in a hurry.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-006.title: A Squeaky Bike
dlg.ev.ch1.road-006.squeak: The bike squeaks with every turn. Rideable, but hard to listen to.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-006.squeak.c2: Ride on to a better spot
dlg.ev.ch1.road-006.look: The culprit: a bag strap brushing a spoke. Repair complete.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-006.later: The squeak keeps time. Now you have a metronome.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-007.title: A View of the Lake
dlg.ev.ch1.road-007.view: The road crests a hill; below, the lake glitters. There's room to stop.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-007.photo: The photo's good. It even shows where you're heading.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-007.glance: The lake isn't going anywhere. You'll see it up close soon.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-008.title: The Lost List
dlg.ev.ch1.road-008.missing: The packing list has vanished. It isn't where it always is.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-008.bag: Found — in the pocket where it was put “so it wouldn’t get lost”.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-008.memory: Tent, sleeping bag, water… It comes out longer than the original.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-008.without: Strangely light without the list. The packing is done; it did its job.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-009.title: A Village Shop
dlg.ev.ch1.road-009.shop: A tiny shop by the road. On the door: “Back in 10 minutes. Probably.”
dlg.ev.ch1.road-009.window: Honey, candles, and a cat asleep on the newspapers. The cat seems to be in charge.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-009.pass: Another time, maybe. That sign looks like it has hung there for years.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-010.title: Wind on the Open Stretch
dlg.ev.ch1.road-010.wind: The forest ends, the fields begin. The wind blows as if it's late too.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-010.slow: Slower, and suddenly there are poppies along the verge.
dlg.ev.ch1.road-010.plan: The plan holds. The wind, it seems, had one of its own.
q.ch1-d2-001.o1: Morning. Yesterday you settled where to sleep and who leads. Look around.
q.ch1-d2-001.o2: The cat has curled up on a warm sleeping bag and is in no hurry to get up.
q.ch1-d2-elise-001.o1: Drop by Elise's and ask how things work here.
q.ch1-d2-camp-001.o1: Dinner: ask Elise about the shared grill by the table.
q.ch1-d2-camp-001.o2: The cat found a sunny patch by the camp. Let her bask.
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c11: Good morning! How do things work here?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c12: Will you show me the new bike area?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c14: May we use the grill tonight?
dlg.elise-greeting.morning: Fires only in the ring by the table. Pine path leads to water.
dlg.elise-greeting.morning.c1: And what about the tent after the dew?
dlg.elise-greeting.morning-tip: Have a good day! Keep things under cover at night — the dew is generous here.
dlg.elise-greeting.bikezone: Here's the new stand under the shelter. Will you check it's easy to use?
dlg.elise-greeting.bikezone.c1: Let's go, I'll take a look.
dlg.elise-greeting.bikezone-yes: Thank you! Now bicycles can find their place more easily.
dlg.elise-greeting.bikezone-no: No problem. Rest is part of the plan, too.
dlg.elise-greeting.bikezone-thanks: Thanks for your help. The bicycles have a place of their own now.
dlg.elise-greeting.dinner: Go ahead, it's for everyone. Cooking together or keeping it simple?
dlg.elise-greeting.dinner-together: Then take the second chopping board — it's by the table.
dlg.elise-greeting.dinner-simple: The best dinner is one without a mountain of dishes afterwards.
q.ch1-d2-fire-001.o1: Dinner is done. The family gathers by the fire as the day winds down.
dlg.ch1-fire.title: An evening together
dlg.ch1-fire.open: The evening of day two. Everyone gathers together.
dlg.ch1-fire.fire: The campfire crackles quietly. Dinner's done, and everyone sits in a circle.
dlg.ch1-fire.lantern: No campfire tonight. We sit under the awning; the lantern glows warm and steady.
dlg.ch1-fire.lantern-george: George: “That's for the dark. Perfectly logical.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l1: Victoria: “Well, our first night is over, and we're still talking to each other.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l2: George: “I considered that part of the plan.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l3: Matthew: “Your list had nine items. Talking wasn't one of them.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l4: George: “The list can still be improved a little.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l5: Victoria: “Or we could leave it alone until morning?”
dlg.ch1-fire.l6-photo: Matthew: “I took a photo of the tent. It looks better than when we pitched it.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l6-plain: Matthew: “From here, the tent looks better than it did while we were putting it up.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l7: George: “That's because we don't have to put it up right now.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l7.c1: Let's each share one good thing
dlg.ch1-fire.l7.c2: Let's just be here for a while
dlg.ch1-fire.l8: Victoria: “I liked that everyone did something. Even when we didn't do everything according to plan.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l9: Matthew: “Next time, I want to choose the route myself.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l10: George: “Deal. You'll show us the options, and we'll check the route and budget together.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l11: Victoria: “Now that sounds like a holiday, not a meeting.”
dlg.ch1-fire.l12-photo: Matthew: “Great. I'll call this photo ‘The Meeting That Accidentally Became a Holiday.’”
dlg.ch1-fire.l12-plain: Matthew: “Great. Let's call tonight ‘The Meeting That Accidentally Became a Holiday.’”
dlg.ch1-fire.b1: Matthew: “I can take a photo of the lake. No speech required.”
dlg.ch1-fire.b2: George: “Deal. Finally, a task without nine steps.”
dlg.ch1-fire.b3: Victoria: “Our places differ, and so do our habits. But this evening is ours to share.”
wave.ch1-home-departure.hook: George announces: we leave at six. By the door — a pile of things that is not luggage yet.
wave.ch1-home-departure.fallback: Departure at 18:20. Nothing lost. Victoria: "We're going on holiday, not sitting a packing exam."
wave.ch1-home-departure.all-done: Six sharp. Victoria: "I can't believe it." George: "I can. I wrote it down." Ready to go.
wave.ch1-home-departure.mia-carrier: Find Mia (sofa, box or windowsill) and get her into the carrier. Leader only.
wave.ch1-home-departure.mia-carrier.done: Mia is in the carrier. On George's list she is now "in charge of logistics".
wave.ch1-home-departure.mia-carrier.late: Mia turned up on the windowsill when everyone was already at the door. Leaving a bit later.
wave.ch1-home-departure.map-to-luggage: Find the map and put it in the luggage. Yourself, or ask Matthew.
wave.ch1-home-departure.map-to-luggage.d: The map is in the luggage. Matthew photographs the bags: "If we lose it, we'll have proof it existed."
wave.ch1-home-departure.map-to-luggage.l: The map was found in a shoe. Leaving a bit later than the list said.
wave.ch1-home-departure.lights-window: Turn off the lights and close the window. In the family, that's George's job.
wave.ch1-home-departure.lights-window.do: Lights off, window closed. George: "I have a list. And a list for the list."
wave.ch1-home-departure.lights-window.la: The window came to mind on the stairs. Went back, closed it. Victoria: "Did you put the list itself on the list?"
wave.ch1-home-departure.anna-goodbye: Confirm with Anna that Mia stays with her, and say goodbye. The bike trip doesn't start without it.
wave.ch1-home-departure.anna-goodbye.don: Anna took Mia along with her blanket. A short goodbye: Mia is already watching the window.
wave.ch1-home-departure.anna-goodbye.lat: Anna came by herself when the bikes were already outside. Mia went to hers with her whole blanket.
wave.ch1-day1-road.hook: At a safe stop you can see the clouds coming. Half an hour until rain.
wave.ch1-day1-road.fallback: A few things are damp — they'll dry later. Victoria: "A bit wet. But all together."
wave.ch1-day1-road.all-done: Arrived before the rain. Matthew: "The rain is late. Not us, this time."
wave.ch1-day1-road.fix-luggage: Fix the luggage — only here, at the stop, never on the move. Ask George.
wave.ch1-day1-road.fix-luggage.done: Luggage secured. George checked every strap twice — the second time for the list.
wave.ch1-day1-road.fix-luggage.late: The luggage shifted a little and the rain found the bags. A few things are damp.
wave.ch1-day1-road.mia-water-blanket: Water for Mia and a blanket over the carrier. Leader only.
wave.ch1-day1-road.mia-water-blanket.don: Mia drank and hid under the blanket. Victoria: "She's the only one ready for rain."
wave.ch1-day1-road.mia-water-blanket.lat: Mia got her water at the lake. Displeased but dry: the carrier stayed inside the car.
wave.ch1-day1-road.check-route: Check the route: the shortcut through the village or the main road. Matthew shows both. Leader only.
wave.ch1-day1-road.check-route.done: Route chosen. Matthew: "Navigator confirms. Navigator would also like a snack."
wave.ch1-day1-road.check-route.late: George: "We're not lost. We're just checking where we are once more." Arrived a bit later.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.hook: At the stop you can see the clouds coming. Half an hour until rain. Mia is at home with Anna.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.fallback: A few things are damp — they'll dry later. Everyone here, everyone together.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.all-done: Arrived before the rain. Matthew: "The rain is late. Not us, this time."
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.patch-tyre: Patch the tyre. George or Matthew — whoever has the skill.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.patch-tyre.done: The tyre holds. Matthew: "A patch is part of the route too."
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.patch-tyre.late: The tyre needed pumping twice more. Slower, but we got there.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.bag-covers: Covers on the bags while it's dry.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.bag-covers.done: Bags under covers. The rain may begin.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.bag-covers.late: The covers came to mind with the first drops. A few things are damp.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.pick-path: Choose the path: under the trees or in the open. Leader only.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.pick-path.done: Path chosen. A change of plan is not a failure — it's a plan.
wave.ch1-day1-road-bike.pick-path.late: We rode on as we were. George: "We're not lost. We're just checking where we are once more."
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.hook: Elise looks at the sky: "Twenty minutes and it pours. The shelter next to me is free."
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.fallback: The downpour came. The tent is wet — we'll dry it tomorrow. George: "Wet, but standing. That counts."
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.all-done: Elise: "Now that's speed. The rain arrived and you're already home." Victoria: "Now it looks like a camp, not a warehouse with a view."
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.pick-spot: Choose the pitch. Elise: "Pick a place where you'll be glad to wake up." Leader only.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.pick-spot.done: Pitch chosen: flat, dry, lake in view from the doorstep.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.pick-spot.late: The pitch was chosen in the rain — the nearest one. Not bad.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.pitch-tent: Pitch the tent: unfold, frame, pegs. In the family, that's George's job.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.pitch-tent.done: The tent stands. George on the uneven ground: "I'm negotiating with it." Matthew: "The lake's visible. Photo after the floor."
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.pitch-tent.late: The tent went up in the downpour. George: "Wet, but standing. That counts." Dry it tomorrow.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.gear-shelter: Things under the shelter. Victoria: "Dry things first, before the rain starts." Ask Matthew or Victoria.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.gear-shelter.done: Things under the shelter, dry. Victoria is pleased with the order — a rare moment.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.gear-shelter.late: The rain caught some of the things. Nothing serious — they'll dry by the tent.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.mia-car: Mia to a dry, quiet place: the car, away from the bustle. Leader only.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.mia-car.done: Mia is in the car, on the blanket. Watching the rain from the right side of the glass.
wave.ch1-day1-arrival.mia-car.late: Mia moved into the carrier by herself and waited out the rain there. Dry, displeased by the noise.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.hook: The fire has just caught, and dinner is not ready yet.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.fallback: Tonight it's a talk by the lantern. The evening is no worse for it.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.all-done: Everything in time. The fire is roaring, dinner is on the table — sit down.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.dinner.done: Victoria: “Dinner's ready, the gear is drying. Finally the ‘rest’ item on the plan.”
wave.ch1-day2-evening.dinner.late: Dinner a little later than planned. Nobody is hungry enough to argue.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.firewood: Firewood before the fire dies: buy from Elise or gather brushwood where allowed. Hand it to Matthew.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.firewood.done: The fire is roaring. Wood stacked, sparks flying up.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.firewood.late: Matthew: “An evening without a fire can be photographed too. If there's light.”
wave.ch1-day2-evening.find-mia: Mia is “on a tour”. Find her: by the pines, under the bench or by the bike shelter.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.find-mia.done: Mia found under the bench. Displeased that the tour was interrupted.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.find-mia.late: Mia comes back on her own and settles on the blanket. Matthew: “Tour over. Without us.”
wave.ch1-day2-evening.cover-bikes: Cover the bikes for the night.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.cover-bikes.done: Bikes under the tarp. Anna sent a photo: Mia at home, in her spot.
wave.ch1-day2-evening.cover-bikes.late: The bikes get wet till morning — we'll wipe them down. Anna sent a photo of Mia anyway.
q.ch1-d3-001.o1: Last morning by the lake. Time to pack up for home — no rush.
q.ch1-d3-001.o2: Mia is asleep on George's list. He 'checks' it without moving the cat.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o1: George checked: everything is dry and intact. Just repack the luggage for the road.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o1.tent-wet: The tent is damp and won't fold. George: “It was smaller when we unpacked it.” Dry it under the shelter or fold it as is.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o1.tent-worn: The tent got crumpled on the road. Victoria: “It just knows how much stuff we have now.” Fold it carefully.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o1.sleeping-bag-wet: The sleeping bag is damp and the zip sticks. Matthew: “Maybe it doesn't want the holiday to end.” Dry it under the shelter.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o1.sleeping-bag-worn: The sleeping bag zip sticks. George: “Then it can start with a proper zip.” Smooth the fabric and zip it gently.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o2: Your gear is dry and intact. Just repack the luggage for the road.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o2.tent-wet: The tent is damp and won't fold — as if it grew overnight. Dry it under the shelter or fold it as is.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o2.tent-worn: The tent got crumpled on the road and folds reluctantly. Fold it carefully — it has more trips in it.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o2.sleeping-bag-wet: The sleeping bag is damp and the zip sticks. Dry it under the shelter — the ride home will be lighter.
q.ch1-d3-gear-001.o2.sleeping-bag-worn: The sleeping bag zip sticks. Smooth the fabric and zip it gently — it has more trips in it.
q.ch1-d3-elise-001.o1: Drop by Elise at reception: say goodbye or ask what you wanted.
q.ch1-d3-return-001.o1: Head out on the road home. The lake stays behind; the memories come with you.
q.ch1-d3-home-001.o1: Get back home. The first trip is done — not perfect, but all ours.
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c15: We're packing up for home. Thanks for everything!
dlg.elise-greeting.goodbye: It was lovely having you. The lake isn't going anywhere — come back.
dlg.elise-greeting.goodbye-road: Then have an easy ride. And a dry tent next time!
dlg.elise-greeting.goodbye-quiet: In May, on weekdays. The lake is almost yours then.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.hook: Elise: “At eleven a new family arrives at your pitch.”
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.fallback: Elise gives you another half hour: “It's fine. The new family likes to sleep in too.”
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.all-done: Elise: “Thanks for leaving it clean. A good trip ends as carefully as it begins.” Camp left tidy.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.walk-site: Walk the pitch and gather your things. Ask Matthew.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.walk-site.done: Matthew: “I found a wrapper. It's not part of the collection.”
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.walk-site.late: George: “Let's check once more. I don't want our socks to become a local landmark.”
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.clean-up: Clean up: pegs, litter, charcoal. Anyone — the leader confirms. Key back to Elise.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.clean-up.done: Pitch clean, key with Elise. Victoria: “Cleaning up after yourself is part of the trip too.”
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.clean-up.late: The last peg turned up by the road. Went back, returned the key — later than planned.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.pack-tent: Pack the tent. If wet — ten minutes under the shelter, or carry it as is. George's job.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.pack-tent.done: Tent packed. George: “Dry. Almost. We'll finish at home.”
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.pack-tent.late: The tent travelled wet. At home it will have to go up once more — on the balcony.
wave.ch1-day3-checkout.mia-carrier-home: Mia into the carrier before the trip home. Leader only.
Mia is in the carrier, looking at the lake as if she left something here.
Mia climbed into the carrier herself when she saw the tent disappearing. She understood before we did.
dlg.elise-greeting.farewell: Packing up already? I was just thinking of you.
dlg.elise-greeting.goodbye-litter: Thanks for the bags by the water — I saw. Nobody asks; people just do it.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-001.title: A box instead of a carrier
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-001.scene: Mia has ignored the carrier. She is sitting in the lantern box, looking extremely pleased.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-001.scene.c2: Put the box into the carrier
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-001.a: The box rides with special privileges. Mia purrs like a small engine.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-001.b: Box in carrier, Mia in box. Cramped, but she calls it luxury.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-002.title: A lantern under the cat
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-002.scene: The lantern has vanished. It turns out Mia is lying on it like a throne.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-002.scene.c1: Swap the lantern for a blanket
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-002.a: Blanket accepted, lantern returned. Mia looks as if it was her idea all along.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-002.b: The lantern stays a throne. Light can wait; Mia matters more right now.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-003.title: Mia on the map
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-003.scene: You unfold the map. Mia lies down exactly on the lake, which is your campsite.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-003.scene.c1: Read the route around her paw
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-003.scene.c2: Give her the map for a minute
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-003.a: The route reads fine around the edges. The campsite stays under her paw, for safety.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-003.b: A minute of quiet. The lake will wait; Mia seems to be there already.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-004.title: A crow outside
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-004.scene: A crow stands by the roadside. Mia watches it as if it owed her money.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-004.scene.c1: Explain the crow is just busy
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-004.a: Mia listens, then looks away. The crow is, apparently, acquitted.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-004.b: The investigation lasts until the next bend. The crow never knew.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-005.title: The cheese bag
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-005.scene: Mia is sniffing the cheese bag. Very professionally, and very closely.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-005.scene.c1: Put some of her food in her bowl
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-005.a: Food in the bowl, cheese in the bag. Diplomacy worked; the deal is verbal.
dlg.ev.ch1.mia-005.b: The bag moves up. Mia memorises the spot and waits for her next chance.
dlg.amina-chat.hello: Hallo! I'm Amina from the guest centre. Looking for something to do?
dlg.amina-chat.hello.c2: Do you really speak three languages?
dlg.amina-chat.a: Evenings, people gather on the pier for music. I checked the schedule twice, it's right.
dlg.amina-chat.b: Sometimes all three in one sentence. My mistakes are our secret, deal?
dlg.amina-chat.bye: Bonjour, and have a lovely day! The centre is open till seven.
dlg.luc-chat.hello: Hi there! I'm Luc, I fix bikes. Anything that spins, bring it to me.
dlg.luc-chat.hello.c1: Could you show me how it's done?
dlg.luc-chat.a: Look first, then touch. Tighten it with me, then on your own.
dlg.luc-chat.b: Quick means it doesn't break a second time. So: tea, and time.
dlg.luc-chat.bye: Workshop is nine to six. Lunch at one is sacred.
dlg.nora-chat.hello: Hi! I'm Nora. One bike, one yellow tent, heading for the sea.
dlg.nora-chat.a: A week, by plan. With scenic detours, longer. I always add extra kilometres.
dlg.nora-chat.b: Dawn is the best. After lunch I look for shade and a view.
dlg.nora-chat.bye: My tent is the yellow one. Drop by if you see a light on!
dlg.ingrid-chat.hello: Oh, has anyone seen my glasses? Ah, they're on me. I'm Ingrid.
dlg.ingrid-chat.hello.c1: What are you writing on the maps?
dlg.ingrid-chat.a: Trails I found myself: shade, springs, lake views. I will hand them on.
dlg.ingrid-chat.b: A map never runs flat. Though my glasses get lost more often.
dlg.ingrid-chat.bye: Come by in the evening, and I'll tell you about one trail.
dlg.sarah-chat.hello: Hi! I'm Sarah, I guide people around here. I know every bench above the lake!
dlg.sarah-chat.a: The one past the third bend: evening light lands on the water.
dlg.sarah-chat.b: At four. Or later? I lost track of time. Tea first!
dlg.sarah-chat.bye: Groups at ten and four. Join us if you feel like it!
dlg.claire-chat.hello: Hello! I'm Claire, the vet. Tails and ears are my job.
dlg.claire-chat.hello.c1: Do you really know every animal by name?
dlg.claire-chat.a: All of them. I ask after Fluffy first, the humans second.
dlg.claire-chat.b: Clinic in the morning, house calls after lunch. And I can't say no — walk-ins welcome.
dlg.claire-chat.bye: If you need advice about an animal on the road, just ask. I am nearby.
dlg.victoria-chat.hello: Lovely spot, isn't it? So quiet here. I'd stay one more evening.
dlg.victoria-chat.a: Very much. Water, pines and no to-do list. It has been a while.
dlg.victoria-chat.b: We could see the lake or sit by the fire. You choose.
dlg.victoria-chat.bye: I'm right here if you need me. And don't forget to drink water.
dlg.matthew-chat.hello: Oh, hey. Taking a few photos. Look at this shot of the pier.
dlg.matthew-chat.hello.c2: How do you like the camp?
dlg.matthew-chat.a: Here: the lake at dawn. Looks painted. The phone lies a bit about colours, though.
dlg.matthew-chat.b: Pretty good, actually. A place to hide, and a place to come back out.
dlg.matthew-chat.bye: Yeah, catch you later. If the light's good, I'll call you.
title.2.family: Victoria: “Found the lantern in a blink. That’s habit for you.”
title.3.family: George: “Plan B in my pocket, and I breathe easier.”
title.4.family: Matthew: “Dad, those ropes actually listen to you. Weird.”
title.5.family: Victoria: “Dinner by the burner tastes best. Thanks, chef.”
title.6.family: Matthew: “Dry socks are a superpower. Put it in the atlas.”
title.7.family: George: “Pedalling and thinking about life. I like it this way.”
title.9.family: Matthew: “Small adventures, and the map is already full. Cool.”
title.10.family: George: “Captain, the course is wherever we like. Together.”
skill.planning.r1.unlock: You see how long the road will take.
skill.planning.r2.unlock: A fallback option appears in events.
skill.planning.r3.unlock: Shortcut: a second road shows up on the map.
skill.planning.r4.unlock: A weather-based gear check before you leave.
skill.planning.r5.unlock: Trails off the map — a lesson from Ingrid.
skill.camping.r1.unlock: A hint on where to pitch.
skill.camping.r3.unlock: A wet-gear zone: nothing gets soaked in rain.
skill.camping.r4.unlock: Two ways to set up your pitch.
skill.mechanics.r5.unlock: Advanced diagnostics from Luc: a camper without surprises.
skill.electrics.r2.unlock: Power-saving mode for lantern and phone.
skill.electrics.r3.unlock: A spot for the camp lantern and the site cable.
skill.electrics.r5.unlock: An evening scene and a solar panel from Luc.
skill.cooking.r1.unlock: A simple dish on the burner.
skill.cooking.r2.unlock: A second dish on the menu.
skill.cooking.r3.unlock: A road snack and dinner under the awning in rain.
skill.finance.r1.unlock: You see the price before you confirm.
skill.finance.r3.unlock: A reserve we don’t touch, and the second-hand market.
skill.finance.r5.unlock: A camper savings gauge from Amina.
skill.endurance.r1.unlock: A hint when you’re getting tired.
skill.endurance.r3.unlock: Weight balancing: a 60 km bike day.
skill.communication.r5.unlock: Group scenes and five phrases in the local language.
sticker.plan.text: We decided to go together, not 'someday'.
sticker.lake.text: Our first arrival at a campsite.
sticker.tent.text: We chose the tent spot ourselves.
sticker.apple.text: Took an apple from the roadside box and left a 'Thanks!'.
sticker.fire.text: Our first evening by the fire together.
req.nora-shore.goal: Pick up three pieces of litter on the shore.
dlg.nora-chat.gate: Oh, hi! You came just in time.
dlg.nora-chat.offer: Someone littered the waterside. Can you pick up three pieces?
dlg.nora-chat.accepted: Thanks! It is all lying on the shore, right by the water.
dlg.nora-chat.later: No rush. The shore is not going anywhere.
dlg.nora-chat.reminder: The litter is still on the shore. Take your time.
dlg.nora-chat.turnin: The shore is clean! Thank you, that was really kind.
dlg.nora-chat.closing: A clean shore, a clean conscience. The gulls are happier too.
req.ingrid-birds.goal: Stand quietly on the pier and watch the birds.
dlg.ingrid-chat.gate: Shh. Hi. Whisper, everything hears you here.
dlg.ingrid-chat.offer: The birds by the pier are shy. Will you stand still and watch from afar?
dlg.ingrid-chat.accepted: Thanks. Stand on the pier and do not move. They will get used to you.
dlg.ingrid-chat.later: Fine. The birds are in no hurry.
dlg.ingrid-chat.reminder: Pier, silence, patience. The birds almost trust you.
dlg.ingrid-chat.turnin: Did you see them? They never saw you. Perfect.
dlg.ingrid-chat.closing: The birds have no idea they were models today.
req.luc-chain: The squeak the whole camp heard
req.luc-chain.goal: Check the chain on Luc’s bike.
dlg.luc-chat.gate: Oh, hi! Hear that? It is not the wind, it is my bike.
dlg.luc-chat.offer: My chain squeaks across the whole camp. Will you check it with me?
dlg.luc-chat.accepted: Great! The bike stands by the south tents. Check the chain.
dlg.luc-chat.later: Fine. The squeak is not going anywhere. Sadly.
dlg.luc-chat.reminder: The chain is waiting. It is squeaking with impatience.
dlg.luc-chat.turnin: Found where it squeaked? I can almost hear the silence.
dlg.luc-chat.closing: It squeaks quieter now. Or I am standing further away.
req.elise-lantern.goal: Find Elise’s spare lantern among the tents.
dlg.elise-greeting.offer: My spare lantern has gone missing. Will you look for it around camp?
dlg.elise-greeting.accepted: Thanks! Last time it was somewhere between the tents.
dlg.elise-greeting.later: Alright. It is nearby, I can feel it.
dlg.elise-greeting.reminder: No lantern yet? Look between the tents.
dlg.elise-greeting.turnin: It is! It really is! You saved my evening.
dlg.elise-greeting.closing: The lantern was looking for itself and found itself. Thanks!
req.sarah-snack.goal: Find a cookie and an apple: a snack within budget.
journal.f.req-sarah-snack-done: put together a snack for Sarah
dlg.sarah-chat.gate: Hi! I keep counting prices, and the money still melts.
dlg.sarah-chat.offer: I want a snack within budget. Can you find a cookie and an apple?
dlg.sarah-chat.accepted: Great! The cookies are by reception, apples somewhere close.
dlg.sarah-chat.later: Okay. The budget can rest along with us.
dlg.sarah-chat.reminder: A cookie and an apple: two items, one budget.
dlg.sarah-chat.turnin: It all fit the budget! Well done.
dlg.sarah-chat.closing: The plan is now called “one cookie”.
req.nora-camera.goal: Find Nora's camera. It was last seen on the meadow.
journal.f.req-nora-camera-done: found Nora's camera, it was under Mia
dlg.nora-chat.offer2: I lost my camera. I'm almost ready to go home. Help me look?
dlg.nora-chat.accepted2: Thanks! Traveller's rule: lost something? Retrace your steps. Start at the meadow.
dlg.nora-chat.later2: Okay. I'll pack my tent meanwhile. I might change my mind.
dlg.nora-chat.reminder2: Camera's still missing. Follow my steps: bench, meadow.
dlg.nora-chat.turnin2: It's fine. Thanks for not giving up the search.
dlg.nora-chat.closing2: We saved not a camera but my dream. Now I will definitely reach the sea.
req.ingrid-starmap.goal: Collect the four pieces of Ingrid's star map.
journal.f.req-ingrid-starmap-done: put the star map together with Ingrid by the fire
dlg.ingrid-chat.offer2: My star map fell into four pieces. The wind. Put it together by evening?
dlg.ingrid-chat.accepted2: Four pieces are scattered around camp. Someone has probably picked up the fourth.
dlg.ingrid-chat.later2: Fine. The stars aren't going anywhere. At least until morning.
dlg.ingrid-chat.reminder2: Pieces are scattered around camp. Someone already picked one up.
dlg.ingrid-chat.turnin2: All four! Let's go to the fire, it's darker there and the sky shows better.
dlg.ingrid-chat.sky1: By the fire Ingrid holds the map to the sky: "The Big Dipper. The ladle."
dlg.ingrid-chat.sky2: "That's Cassiopeia, a W. The Swan flies over the lake. See the cross of stars?"
dlg.ingrid-chat.closing2: The map is whole. I carry the whole sky over the lake in my pocket.
req.luc-radio.goal: Connect the wires of the old radio so music plays in camp.
journal.f.req-luc-radio-done: fixed Luc's radio, music played in camp
dlg.luc-chat.offer2: Now the radio. Silent as a fish. Its wires are loose. Will you help?
dlg.luc-chat.accepted2: The radio sits by the path to the south tents. Connect the wires.
dlg.luc-chat.later2: No problem. The radio will think it over. It likes to think.
dlg.luc-chat.reminder2: The wires are waiting. Red to red, blue to blue. You know the rest.
dlg.luc-chat.turnin2: Hear that? It plays! Music over the whole camp, even the gulls went quiet.
dlg.luc-chat.closing2: You can't hear the chain squeak over the songs. That's a win too.
sticker.nora-camera.text: Nora found her camera, and her dream of the sea.
sticker.starmap.text: Four pieces, one sky over the lake.
sticker.radio.text: The old radio played and the whole camp sang along.
dlg.nora-chat.found: Is that my camera you've got? Let me see!
dlg.nora-chat.found-mia: The camera! Under Mia, and warm. Always check where the cat sleeps.
dlg.nora-chat.found-bag: The camera! In the grass, under Matthew's backpack. He never noticed.
dlg.ingrid-chat.sky3-mia: "On the fourth piece Mia left a paw print. Let it be a new constellation."
dlg.ingrid-chat.sky3-matthew: "Matthew found the fourth piece. Let the new constellation be his."
dlg.fish-keep.title: Catch for dinner
dlg.fish-keep.n: The fish is heavy and shiny. It can be cleaned quietly by the water, no rush. Dinner will have a catch in it.
dlg.fish-release.title: The fish swims on
dlg.fish-release.n: The fish flicked its tail and vanished into the deep. Dinner will come from our own supplies, and the lake keeps its own.
dlg.ch1-fire.fk1: Victoria: "Fish from the campfire. George forgot his list."
dlg.ch1-fire.fk1c: Victoria: "Charred skin is the best part. Don't apologise, we'll eat it all."
dlg.ch1-fire.fkl: Victoria: "No campfire, so the fish went on the stove. Smells wonderful."
dlg.ch1-fire.fk2: George: "One catch, several portions, nothing from the plan. Dinner worked."
dlg.ch1-fire.fk3: Matthew: "I got the best portion, and I won't ask why. Thanks for the fish."
dlg.ch1-fire.fr1: Victoria: "The fish swam on, rightly so. Dinner is our own supplies."
dlg.ch1-fire.fr2: Nora: "Good evening! I have far too many honey biscuits. Will you share some?"
dlg.ch1-fire.fr3: Nora holds out a small parcel of biscuits.
dlg.ch1-fire.fr3.c1: Thank you, Nora! Sit with us
dlg.ch1-fire.fr3.c2: That's kind, Nora. Enjoy it with us
dlg.ch1-fire.fr4: Nora: "You're kind people. Have a lovely evening, and stay warm."
dlg.ch1-fire.fr5: George: "Honey biscuits weren't in the plan. I'm adding them retroactively."
journal.f.fish-released: let the fish go, and Nora brought a treat
journal.f.trust-nora-fish: Nora trusts the family more: they accepted her treat
dlg.nora-chat.warm: My pleasure! I love a camp that shares warmth. Come by again.
dlg.cashier-chat.hello: Welcome! I am Lotte. Where to: mountains, a lake, or away from schedules?
dlg.cashier-chat.a: Then take a dry bag. Rain always arrives right after the tent is up.
dlg.cashier-chat.b: Check the tent poles at home. Better to find a broken one indoors.
dlg.cashier-chat.bye: Look all you like. The door chime will greet you next time too.
